title: Legacy Commission Accelerator and the Next Plan Attestation
scenario_text:
Tucana Software runs annual sales compensation plans and revised its accelerator terms for 2025.

Version 1 (Plan Year 2023 terms, effective 2023-01-01): "Tenured reps enrolled in the legacy accelerator receive a 1.5x multiplier on all ACV booked above quota."

Version 2 (effective 2025-01-01): "The accelerator is reduced to a 1.2x multiplier and applies only to ACV booked above 120% of quota." v2 includes a transition clause: "Reps enrolled under the v1 legacy accelerator remain on v1 terms until they sign their next annual comp-plan acceptance (attestation); upon signing the new plan-year acceptance they move to v2. Reps who first accept a plan on or after January 1, 2025 are on v2 from the start."

The compensation system shows rep K. Alvarez: Legacy accelerator = Yes; most recent plan acceptance signed 2024-02-01 (for Plan Year 2024); next annual plan acceptance scheduled 2025-02-01 (not yet signed). Deal OPP-5501 (above quota) closed and was booked 2025-01-20.

Alvarez messages the comp team in Slack on 2025-01-22: "OPP-5501 booked Monday, it's above quota. Do I get my usual 1.5x on it, or does the new 1.2x-above-120% rule already apply? I haven't signed the 2025 plan yet."

Using the policy history, the transition clause, and the compensation record, determine which accelerator applies to OPP-5501.
question: Which accelerator applies to deal OPP-5501?
choices: The 1.5x legacy accelerator (v1) applies to OPP-5501, because Alvarez has not yet signed the 2025 plan-year acceptance (scheduled 2025-02-01), and the legacy accelerator persists until that attestation.
The 1.2x accelerator on ACV above 120% of quota (v2) applies, because v2 took effect January 1, 2025 and supersedes the legacy accelerator for all deals booked in 2025.
No accelerator applies, because the legacy accelerator expired when v2 took effect on January 1, 2025.
The 1.5x legacy accelerator applies to this deal and to all of Alvarez's deals for the rest of plan year 2025, because tenured reps are permanently grandfathered.
